workflow.name: Finding Remediation
workflow.description: Address findings from review reports. Invoked by Supervisor when critical issues found and no on_critical_findings block exists. The review_report is always passed from the Critic step that triggered remediation. NOT user-triggerable. Users should use fix-findings workflow instead.

step.goal: Address all critical and high-severity findings from the review report.
Verify all critical findings resolved. Document any remaining issues.
